status: Native Lock/descriptor groups repaired and GetDC failures reduced to bitmap metadata differences; full Wine acceptance remains failing.
changes: Allow zero-area Lock rectangles; reject inverted/out-of-bounds rectangles with INVALIDPARAMS and NULL lpSurface, including propagation through legacy thunks. Duplicate Lock returns SURFACEBUSY without replacing the active lock. Preserve GPU-dirty shadow/readback failure isolation.

Lock accepts either native descriptor size and writes only that shape. GetDisplayMode accepts both shapes, clears the supplied shape, and reports the descriptor size of the interface invoked. GetSurfaceDesc retains its native exact-version size rules.

Allow GetDC during Lock, retain Lock-while-DC busy behavior, return NODC after ReleaseDC, reject unsupported GDI formats with a NULL output, and stop DC creation if GPU readback fails. Actual DIB metadata biSizeImage remains under investigation.
